candidate_sentences.text: Flight package tours remained the main business and generated EUR 145.1 million in sales, down 15.0%, but segment sales profit increased 18.0% to EUR 12.2 million.
Its sales profit margin rose to 8% from 1%, supported by a higher gross margin and lower commission expenses.
By contrast, sightseeing-tour sales declined, with sales profit from plane tours falling 84.4% to EUR 135 thousand.

verified_key_information_units.information: The company intentionally reduced volumes on loss-making routes and prioritized higher-margin destinations, leveraging its broad portfolio to improve margins and operational efficiency despite overall revenue decline.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword (page 4): 'We intentionally reduced volumes and optimised our travel programme... reduced volumes on loss-making routes and placed greater emphasis on higher-margin destinations... improve margins and operational efficiency.' Improved Efficiency section details this strategy.

candidate_sentences.text: The improvement reflected tighter control of the travel programme, the removal of loss-making routes and greater emphasis on higher-margin destinations.

verified_key_information_units.information: 2025 results were constrained by intense competition, excess market supply in autumn affecting prices, and disruptions at Vilnius Airport from illegal cross-border activity involving unmanned balloons that reduced last-minute travel demand.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword (page 4): 'operated in an environment of intense competition and excess travel supply... increase in market-wide supply during the autumn season put pressure on prices... disruptions at Vilnius Airport related to illegal cross-border activity involving unmanned balloons reduced last-minute travel demand.'

candidate_sentences.text: The Group operated amid intense competition and excess travel supply.
Autumn market-wide supply growth pressured prices, while disruptions at Vilnius Airport associated with illegal cross-border balloon activity reduced last-minute demand.

verified_key_information_units.information: For 2026, the company plans a similar or slightly higher travel programme level, focusing on operational and cost efficiency and expanding its hotel portfolio; early bookings for the 2026 summer season were 59% higher year-on-year, with new destinations including Morocco and Mallorca.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword (page 4): 'For 2026, we currently plan our travel programme at a similar or slightly higher level... focus on operational and cost efficiency... expand our hotel portfolio... bookings for the 2026 summer season were 59 percent higher... new destinations: Morocco and Mallorca.'

candidate_sentences.text: Early bookings for the 2026 summer season were 59% higher by December 2025, and the Group planned a similar or slightly larger programme, including new Morocco and Mallorca offerings.

verified_key_information_units.information: Liquidity improved with cash and cash equivalents rising to EUR 1.69 million (from EUR 0.39 million in 2024), but leverage increased significantly as debt/equity ratio climbed to 191.42% (from 121.16% in 2024); the group held EUR 21 million in travel guarantees secured by insurance policies and bank guarantees, with EUR 4.5 million cash deposits against these.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated statements of financial position (page 18): cash and cash equivalents EUR 1,691k (2025) vs EUR 394k (2024); debt/equity ratio 191.42% (2025) vs 121.16% (2024). Notes to financial statements (page 25): 'travel guarantees amounting to EUR 21 million... cash deposits... EUR 4.5 million.'

candidate_sentences.text: Financial leverage increased: borrowings rose to EUR 12.9 million, equity declined to EUR 6.9 million, and the debt-to-equity ratio increased to 191.4% from 121.2%.
Cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 1.7 million, partly supported by EUR 2.2 million of net financing cash inflows, while operating cash flow was negative EUR 656 thousand.
The Group had EUR 21 million of travel guarantees and EUR 4.5 million of related cash deposits, and reported compliance with some, but not all, financial covenants.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K4, K5, K6, and K7 are all PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K3 is PARTIALLY_PRESENT because while it covers the sales decline and margin changes for flight package tours and sightseeing tours, it does not explicitly mention the gross profit margin figures for 2024 (13% for flight package tours and 33% for sightseeing tours) which are core components of the criterion. All other criteria are fully represented, making the overall coverage comprehensive with only a minor omission in K3 that does not change the overall understanding of the report.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support each other without contradictions. The narrative flows from overall performance to specific segments, cost management, market conditions, and financial position. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetition. The relationships between declining revenues, improved margins, and reduced losses are consistently explained throughout the text. The financial leverage increase and cash position are presented without conflicting information. All segment performances (flight packages, sightseeing tours, other sales) are clearly differentiated and contextualized within the overall performance trend.
